en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Kuleyb Bin Muawiya, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I heard himasws saying: ‘It is not befitting for the Momin that he alienates to his brother from the ones below him (in understanding). The Momineen are highly valued people in their Religion’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from Kulayb ibn Mu’awiyah who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘
It does not benefit a believer to be apprehensive of his brother (in belief) of less perfect belief; believers are highly valued people in their religion.’”
